verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's documentation shows a remote MCP server for analyzing data in natural language without writing SQL. It also documents Dives dashboards generated and refined conversationally ("add a filter for US region"), and agent write access through query_rw, so data querying, visualization and modification can all be driven by natural-language commands. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language workflows work as claimed, and evidence that account-level operations (sharing, settings, billing) can be driven this way; the MCP path also relies on an external AI assistant client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The MotherDuck remote MCP Server lets you analyze your data using natural language and generate interactive visualizations, all without writing SQL.
Generate interactive, shareable dashboards from natural language prompts
you iterate conversationally ("add a filter for US region", "switch to a bar chart") and the Viewer updates in place.
Your agents can now INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, create tables, and modify schemas through the MCP — not just SELECT.
